note: Archive hits per scene: tweet ids from searching @notnotnotnotyn (full archive) with 2-4 keywords from the frame. ids: only tweets whose text contains a strong (rare, scene-specific) keyword, strongest first. p: chance a tick pops on this scene (mean strength of its top 5 tweets, mapped 0.8..1.0 -> 0..1); quiet is the normal state. fallback_broad: local-deck ids that match more than 5% of scenes, never popped by the local matcher.
